Notes for the Year 12 Mathematics Standard course, covering both pathways. All students complete the Year 11 focus areas first, then branch into either Standard 1 or Standard 2. Choose your pathway below.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### Standard 1
Algebraic relationships, Investment, Depreciation and loans, Right-angled triangles, Ratios and rates, Bivariate data analysis, and Relative frequency and probability.

[Start here](standard-1/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Standard 2
Algebraic relationships, Investment and loans, Annuities, Trigonometry, Ratios and rates, Network flow, Critical path analysis, Bivariate data analysis, Relative frequency and probability, and The normal distribution.

[Start here](standard-2/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

:::
